newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Seneca Falls CSD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Seneca Falls CSD, N.Y..

text.p: at Roosevelt & Cross Incorporated, 20 Exchange Place,
Bonds dated May 15, 1997, interest June 15 and December 15 each year commencing December 15, 1997. Bonds mature in principal installments on June 15 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Bonds will not be subject to redemption prior to maturity.

The District reserves the right to change the time and or/date of the bid opening, and notice thereof shall be provided at least 24 hours prior to the time set forth above and transmitted over the Munifacts wire.
Bids, accompanied by a $26,000.00 good faith deposit check, must be for all $1,300,000 bonds. Award shall be based on net interest cost.

Bidders must refer to the full Notice of Sale for the complete terms and conditions of the sale. Copies of the Notice and the Official Statement may be promptly obtained from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., Cicero Professional Building, 6221 Route 31, Suite 112, Cicero, New York 13039, telephone number: (315) 699-7912; fax: (315) 699-8833.
